nodes.name: Orion HUD: Deal Closed Alert
nodes.notes: Terminal, non-blocking. Runs after the invoice is sent, so a HUD outage cannot delay or prevent billing. Failures are swallowed by design.

nodes.name: Verify Webhook Signature
nodes.notes: Fail-closed HMAC check. Needs NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto and ESIGN_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Idempotency Guard
nodes.notes: Claim ledger in workflow static data. Blocks repeat billing for the same signed document.

nodes.name: Mark Document Processed
nodes.notes: Commits the idempotency claim. Runs only after the invoice is actually sent.

nodes.name: Resolve Client Folder Name
nodes.notes: Derives + sanitises the client folder name and builds an escaped Drive query.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ name: $('Resolve Client Folder Name').first().json.client_folder_name, mimeType: 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder', parents: [$('Resolve Client Folder Name').first().json.client_folder_parent_id] }) }}

nodes.name: Drive: Create Client Folder
nodes.notes: Creates the client subfolder. Not retried - Drive allows duplicate names.
